title: checkrdepends: add option for DEP8 reverse deps
description:
checkrdepends: add option for DEP8 reverse deps
    
This is an initial (quite simple) implementation of DEP8 reverse dependencies support. It does not compute reverse dependencies expanded through the @recommends@ substvar.
diff:
diff --git a/checkrdepends b/checkrdepends
index d38bc11..a0cdf96 100755
--- a/checkrdepends
+++ b/checkrdepends
@@ -66,6 +66,9 @@ def parse_relation_packages(raw):
             match = re_dep.match(dep.strip())
             if match:
                 dep_list.append(match.group(1))
+            elif dep.strip() in ('@builddeps@'):
+                #TODO: we also need to handle @recommends@ somehow
+                dep_list.append(dep)
         for dep in dep_list:
             yield dep, dep_list
